description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the IS31FL3216A LED controller, including register definitions, initialization, and LED control functions.

methods.name: is31fl3216a_write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer of bytes over I2C to the device.

methods.name: is31fl3216a_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a single register value over I2C.

methods.name: is31fl3216a_update_pwm
methods.description: Triggers PWM update on the device.

methods.name: is31fl3216a_brightness_to_pwm
methods.description: Converts brightness percentage to PWM value.

methods.name: is31fl3216a_led_write_channels
methods.description: Writes PWM values to a range of LED channels.

methods.name: is31fl3216a_led_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets brightness for a specific LED.
